title: Q-ROOT-regression-on-main: regression-on-main keeps recurring: Bisect to the first red commit and revert the smallest change (redmain); add the regression test the change lacked.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe regression-on-main
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `regression-on-main` recurred on 2 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: a change reached main without its own checks proving it green on the code that merges
Guard: `grep:foundation/redmain.py::def`
Remedy: Bisect to the first red commit and revert the smallest change (redmain); add the regression test the change lacked.
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:foundation-tests: foundation-tests a foundation check regressed or a test depends on the host tional elements.
First extra element 0:
'sit
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe regression-on-main

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T18:31:37Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-23T11:11:40Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: guard passes; last occurrence 2026-11-21
